verdict.rationale: Swell's docs mention third-party gateways (Braintree, a PayPal gateway for direct card payments) and support local-currency pricing with dynamic currency conversion. Local-currency charging is limited to 'supported payment gateways', and gateway choice appears only in changelog entries. Missing for 10: a documented list of available gateways and how merchants select or configure them, which gateways support multi-currency charging, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a merchant, I can choose among third-party payment gateways and charge in multiple currencies when the built-in option doesn't fit

citations.quote: dynamic currency conversion, plus pricing in local currencies with supported payment gateways
Added Apple Pay support for subscriptions via Braintree.
Implemented PayPal gateway for direct card payments
